I am looking for some information on Credit Union loans in Canada. I am working towards building my credit. I read that I can get a Credit union loan which basically means I don't really take a load but just pay money to a credit union until a certain point which will help me save money and build a good credit.

Does anyone has experience with credit union loans?

Let me clear up a few misconceptions. What you're describing is a secured line of credit. Essentially you "borrow" a certain amount from a credit union, e.g. $500. You then "secure" this loan by giving the credit $500 in cash. You then "pay back" the loan + interest over time. Given that the risk to the credit union is nil, the interest rate is low and the "loan" is available even to people with poor or no credit. It's definitely a good way to build credit by developing a reliable payment history.
